basic_info.description: Oceanfront Condo with Iconic Views & Outdoor Recreation Area!  Rare opportunity to live where the ocean meets elegance in this tastefully remodeled ground-floor unit right across Ocean Beach & Golden Gate Park!  Bright and airy  unit with unobstructed ocean vistas!!!  Cross the street and enjoy water sports - sailing, surfing, swimming, fishing, parasailing or simply enjoy a quiet stroll on the beach.  Newly remodeled - the latest wood-look vinyl floor; quartz kitchen countertop with a breakfast bar; newly painted throughout; new shower head; new doorknobs; new faucets.  Bedroom has a mirrored wall that brightens the room!  Enjoy lovely sunsets and watch pelicans and other waterbirds glide above the sea.  Washer/dryer in unit.  Walk-in closet + linen closet.   Exterior recreation area offers 3 BBQ grills and lounge chairs.  Secure underground parking.  Extra storage in garage level. Walk across the street to Safeway, coffee shops and restaurants.  Treat yourself and make this your home or pied-a-terre.  IMAGINE THE CONVENIENCE OF LIVING IN SAN FRANCISCO, YET FEEL LIKE YOU'RE ALWAYS ON VACATION!!!
